acceptance: All three groups must finish the entire queue with correct final states, zero replay, balanced resources, automatic candidate selection, positive full-API net and positive net after source validation/evidence writing
baseline: Separate initial-state native owner runs the identical original immutable queue after the decision. Only its native execution time is credited; no baseline construction cost is added.
candidate: Same total scalar addition identity as the prior owned-state fixture; fresh independent proof/build for each group; only internally admitted proof reuse at selection
deployment_cost_scope: Fixture/proposal construction through runtime.close; every proof/build/owner/calibration/switch/native execution/state/resource check; additionally charge per-group source/tool validation and evidence write in the stricter net gate
motivation: Verify the actual current runtime economics after safe suffix continuation and atomic queue activation/finalization repairs. Round3 positive and earlier negative results are known and remain unchanged; this is a replication, not unseen workloads or a proof that the repairs caused speedup.
registered_workload_changes: none; same three original queues and calibration profile, fixed before any round4 runtime performance execution
required_cost_accounting: actual execution receipt cost_accounting_complete and runtime cost_accounting_complete must remain true; unknown or poisoned accounting cannot support acceptance
scope: Repeat the same three predeclared finite queues after continuation and exception/cost-settlement changes, with a newly restored Clang20.1.8 host toolchain
selection: Existing minimum paired saving forecast with five alternating calibration rounds; no oracle timing used in the decision
separate_audit: The complete post-decision audit API is recorded and excluded from deployment, with no replay on application state
shared_wrapper_costs: Actual common registration/source-byte snapshot/host/final validation costs are allocated equally across the three fixed groups and included in each strict net gate
